biocontainers.name: bioconductor-decomptumor2sig
biocontainers.summary: Decomposition of individual tumors into mutational signatures by signature refitting

biotools.summary: Uses quadratic programming for signature refitting, i.e., to decompose the mutation catalog from an individual tumor sample into a set of given mutational signatures (either Alexandrov-model signatures or Shiraishi-model signatures), computing weights that reflect the contributions of the signatures to the mutation load of the tumor.
